div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reserve launcher
creates one coin at the INNER hash
it is given, for its whole amount
(for a CAT it runs inside the CAT layer)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reserve coin
that inner hash, CAT-wrapped for a CAT
hinted with the launcher id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CreateCoinAnnouncement
'forge-reserve-v14' + tree_hash(
inner_puzzle_hash, amount, launcher_id )
the inner hash, never the wrapped one

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
register, in the same transaction
P_i = coinid( grandparent_i, launcher_hash_i, reserves[i] )
launcher_hash_i is CAT-wrapped for a CAT reserve
the message uses the INNER reserve hash it derives
the grandparent is given; the reserve's own id is never named
